position_overview:
We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Virtual Operations Coordinator, Executive Assistant & Social Media Manager to support the day-to-day operations of an Australian property maintenance business.

This is a multifaceted role combining maintenance job coordination, administrative support, executive assistance, customer service, and social media management. key_responsibilities:
, communicates confidently in English, and can manage competing priorities independently.

Operations & Job Coordination
- Monitor and manage the business inbox, prioritising enquiries and following up outstanding requests.
- Create, update, and track maintenance jobs in Tradify.
- Maintain accurate property records, job details, tenant information, and supporting documentation.
- Coordinate tenant access, appointments, site visits, and maintenance schedules.
- Liaise with property managers, tenants, and approved subcontractors.
- Track job completion documents, photographs, reports, and outstanding administrative requirements.
- Prepare service reports using established templates and distribute approved documents.
- Escalate urgent matters and operational issues to the directors.

Executive & Administrative Support
- Manage calendars, appointments, meetings, and reminders for company directors.
- Organise business documents, records, and digital files.
- Follow up outstanding action items and support daily operational priorities.
- Maintain task trackers and prepare daily operational summaries.
- Identify administrative bottlenecks and suggest improvements to existing workflows.

Customer Service & Communication
- Handle incoming and outgoing business calls professionally.
- Respond to routine enquiries and maintenance requests.
- Provide authorised updates to clients and relevant stakeholders.
- Follow up outstanding quotations, approvals, and correspondence.
- Ensure sensitive, urgent, or commercial matters are escalated appropriately.

Social Media Management
- Assist with managing the business's Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn accounts.
- Adapt and refine supplied content, photographs, and marketing materials for publication.
- Create branded graphics and edit short-form videos as required.
- Write captions, schedule posts, and maintain a consistent brand presence.
- Monitor comments, messages, and incoming social media enquiries.
- Coordinate lead follow-ups and prepare social media performance reports.
- Research relevant trends and opportunities to improve online engagement.

Existing content and materials are expected to be provided for adaptation and refinement; the role is not primarily focused on creating all content from scratch.

Qualifications & Requirements
- Proven experience in operations coordination, administration, executive assistance, or a similar support role
- Hands-on experience with Tradify is strongly preferred.
- Experience with maintenance coordination, property management, trades, construction, or a related industry is an advantage.
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft 365.
- Experience supporting business owners or company directors.
- Excellent written and spoken English, with confidence communicating professionally with Australian stakeholders.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
- Experience managing business social media accounts, including content scheduling and engagement.
- Proficiency in Canva and video-editing tools.
- High attention to detail, accountability, and consistent follow-through.
- Ability to work full-time during Australian business hours.
- Reliable internet connection and a suitable home-office environment.
- Own computer and necessary work equipment suitable for a full-time remote role.

- Employment Type: Full-time
- Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM
- 5:00 PM Australian business hours
- Direct collaboration with company directors.
- A varied role combining business operations, executive support, and digital marketing.
- An opportunity to contribute to a growing business and develop long-term professional relationships.
